The test image shows a soybean leaf with **interveinal chlorosis** — yellow/pale patches between the veins while the midvein and major lateral veins remain distinctly green. This is the hallmark symptom of Sudden Death Syndrome (SDS).

The SDS reference collage confirms this pattern: top-right panel shows the same interveinal yellowing with green veins retained, matching the test image closely. The test image appears to be an early-stage SDS leaf symptom before necrosis fully develops.
